authentication_failure.name: SSH Brute Force Investigation Playbook
l1_steps: Check source IP address and geolocation/reputation if available.
Check targeted usernames.
Check number of failed attempts and time window.
Verify whether successful login happened after failures.
Review authentication logs.
Create or update incident case.
Escalate if successful login occurred or privileged account was targeted.
authentication_failure.containment_recommendation: Block source IP in lab firewall and reset affected account password if compromise is confirmed.
authentication_failure.escalation_condition: Escalate if successful login follows failed attempts, root/admin account is targeted, or activity repeats.

network_scan.name: Network Scanning Investigation Playbook
l1_steps: Identify source IP and target asset.
List scanned ports and exposed services.
Verify whether the scan was approved/internal.
Check for follow-up exploitation attempts.
Review firewall and network logs.
Monitor same source IP for repeated activity.
Escalate if scan targets critical assets or is followed by login/exploit attempts.
network_scan.containment_recommendation: Restrict suspicious source IP and review exposed services.
network_scan.escalation_condition: Escalate if scan targets critical server, sensitive ports, or continues after blocking.

privilege_escalation.name: Privilege Escalation Investigation Playbook
l1_steps: Identify user account involved.
Review sudo/auth logs.
Check command executed.
Verify whether the user is authorized for privilege activity.
Check login source before privilege action.
Correlate with previous brute-force or suspicious login alerts.
Escalate if activity is unauthorized or follows suspicious login.
privilege_escalation.containment_recommendation: Disable suspicious account in lab and preserve evidence logs.
privilege_escalation.escalation_condition: Escalate if unauthorized sudo/root activity is observed.

default.name: Generic SOC L1 Alert Triage Playbook
l1_steps: Validate alert details.
Check affected host and user.
Review related logs.
Check previous activity from same source.
Document evidence.
Decide true positive or false positive.
Escalate if business risk is high.
default.escalation_condition: Escalate if suspicious activity is confirmed.
